name: The Predator
creator: kaizen
description:
**Features:**

- Custom model and textures
- Custom animations
- Custom Voice-over for all languages
- New VFX
- New SFX
- Custom Evolutions
- Custom loading screen and in-game icons
- A skull trophy from the enemy jungler


The Predator, a member of the alien species of Yautja, is here to hunt. Take the jungle as your own and let none live.


It's a total overhaul, turning Kha'Zix into the fearsome Predator. Comes with fully custom animations, unique evolutions (Q for wristblades, W for shoulder cannon, E for the mask and R for mask and skin colour), bloody VFX, satisfying SFX and plenty of the Predator's grunts and growls as the voice-over.
This mod overrides every skin, meaning, no matter which Kha'Zix skin you or the enemy picks in champ select, you will always see the Predator.

CREDITS:
Thank you to NeoXstyles for greatly enhancing the textures, and making new ones for the R evolution.
